regions.title: Central Rockies
regions.text: Telluride leads with 16" through Monday, with 13" on Sunday. Rain and snow mix Sunday, and a Winter Storm Watch runs from Sunday to Monday. Crested Butte has 9" and a Winter Weather Advisory from Sunday to Monday night. Aspen Highlands has 4".

regions.title: Southern Rockies
regions.text: Wolf Creek leads with 16", including 14" on Sunday, under a Winter Storm Watch from Sunday night into Monday. Winds could gust to 45 mph Sunday night. Taos has 9" and a Monday peak of 3". Expect rain at times Sunday, with flooding a concern.

regions.title: Wasatch
regions.text: Snowbird and Alta each have 7" through Wednesday, with 6" on Sunday. The NWS is calling for more, 21 to 35 inches at Alta, Saturday night through Wednesday, and 11 to 21 inches at Snowbird, Sunday through Tuesday night. Brighton has 7".

regions.title: Tahoe
regions.text: Kirkwood has 8" on Saturday, with the NWS calling for 13 to 22 inches Saturday night. A Winter Weather Advisory runs from Saturday to Sunday. Heavenly has 5" Saturday, with 3 to 8 inches more expected Saturday night. Sierra-at-Tahoe has 4" on Saturday.

ahead.text: The Weather Prediction Center says a storm system may bring more snow to western mountains around Friday Nov 6, with its confidence low in the details.
